preconditions.description: The number of boxes n must be between 2 and 100000.
The index of the box x must be between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a) and a[x-1] != 0
preconditions.description: Each box must have between 0 and 10^9 balls, and the box at index x must have at least one ball.

postconditions.description: The output must be the initial arrangement of balls in the boxes as space-separated integers.
The total number of balls before and after Vasya's actions must be the same.
The number of balls in the box at index x must be adjusted based on the distribution of balls.
